text.body:
kṛtārivañcane dṛṣṭiryenāñjanamalīmasā | acyutāya namastasmai paramaucityakāriṇe || 1 || yugmakam kṛtvāpi kāvyālaṅakārāṃ kṣemendraḥ kavikarṇikām | tatkalaṅaṃka vivekañca vidhāya vibudhapriyam || 2 || aucityasya camatkārakāriṇacāruṇaścārucavaṇe | rasajovisya camatkārakāriṇaścārucarvaṇe | rasajovitabhūtasya vicāraṃ kurute'dhunā || 3 || kāvyasyālamalaṅakāraiḥ kiṃ mithyāgaṇitairguṇaiḥ | yasya jovitamaucityaṃ vicintayāpi na vṛśyate || 4 || alaṅakārāstvalaṅakārā guṇā eva guṇāḥ sadā | aucityaṃ rasasiddhasya sthiraṃ kāvyasya jovitam || 5 || narasparopakārakaruciraśabdārtha rūpasya kāvyasyopamotprekṣādayo ye pracurālaṅakārāste kaṭakakuṇḍalakeyūrahārādivadalaṅakārā eva, bāhmaśobhāhetutvāt | ye'pi kāvyaguṇaḥ kecana tallakṣaṇavicaṇaiḥ samāmnātāste'pi śrūtasatyaśelādivad guṇā eva, āhāryatvat | aucityaṃ tvagre vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaṃ sthiramavinaśvaraṃ jīvitaṃ kāvyasya, tena vināsya guṇālaṅakārayuktasyāpi nirjīvatvāt || rasena śrṛṅagārādinā siddhasya prasiddhasya kāvyasya dhātuvādarasasiddhasyeva tajjīvitaṃ sthiramityarthaḥ | uktārthasyaiva viśeṣamāha ucitasthānavinyāsadalaṅkṛtiralaṅkṛtiḥ | aucityādacyutā nityaṃ bhavantayeva guṇā guṇāḥ || 6 || alaṅkṛtirucitasthānavinyāsadalaṅakartu kṣamā bhavati, anyathā tvalaḍ.kṛtivyapadeśameva na labhate | tadvadaucityādaparicyutā guṇā guṇatāmāsadayanti anyathā punaraguṇā eva | yadāha kaṇṭhe mekhalayā nitambayā nitambaphalake tāreṇa hāreṇa vā, pāṇau nūpurabandhanena caraṇe keyūrapāśena vā | śairyeṇa praṇate ripau karuṇayā nāyānti ke hāsyatāmaucityena vinā ruciṃ pratute nālaṅkṛtirno guṇāḥ || kiṃ tadaucityamityāha acitaṃ prāhurācāryāḥ sadṛśaṃ kila yasya yat || acitasya ca yo bhāvastadaucityaṃ pracakṣate || 7 || yatkila yasyānurūpaṃ taducitamucyate, tasya bhāvamaucityaṃ kathayanti | adhunā sakalakāvyaśarorajīvātubhūtasyaucityasya prādhānyenopalabhyāṃ sthitiṃ darśa yitumāha pade vākye prabandhārthe guṇe'laṅakaraṇe rase | kriyāyāṃ kārake liṅega vacane ca viśeṣaṇe || 8 || upasarge nipāte ca kāle deśe kule vrate || tattve sattve'grahe || 9 || pratibhāyāmavasthāyāṃ civāre nāmnayathāśiṣi | kāvyasyāṅageṣu ca prāhuraucityaṃ vyāpi jīvitam || 10 || eteṣu padaprabhṛtiṣu sthāneṣu marmasvava kāvyasya sakalaśarīravyāpi jīvitamaucityaṃ sphuṭatvena sphuradavabhāsate || teṣūdāharaṇāni ṛmeṇa darśayitumāha tilakaṃ bibhratī sūktirbhātyekamucitaṃ padam | candrānaneva kastūrīkṛtaṃ śyāmeva cāndanam || 11 || ekamevo citaṃ padaṃ tilakāyamānaṃ bibhrāṇā sūktiḥ samucitaparabhāgāśe bhatiśayena ruciratāmāvahati | yathā parimalasya magnāni dviṣatāṃ kulāni samare tvatkhaḍgadhārākule, nāthāsminniti vandivāci bahuśo deva śrutāyāṃ purā | mugdhā gurjarabhūmipālamahiṣī pratyāśayā pāthasaḥ, kāntāre cakitā vibhuñcati muhuḥ patyuḥ kṛpāṇe dṛśau || atra mugdhāpadenaucityacamatkāriṇā sūktiḥ śaradinduvadaneva śyāmatilakena śyāyeva śubhraviśeṣakeṇa vibhūṣitā sakalakadikulalalāmabhūtāṃ vicchittimātanoti | na tu yathā dharmakīrteḥ lāvaṇdraviṇavyayo na gaṇitaḥ kleśā mahānsvīkṛtaḥ, svacchandasya sukhaṃ janasya vasataścintājvaro nimiṃtaḥ | eṣāpi svayameva tulyaramaṇā bhāvādvarākī hatā, ko'rthaścetasi vedhasā vinihitastanvayāstanuṃ tanvatā || atra tanvayāḥ iti padaṃ kevalaśabdānuprāsavyasanitayā nibaddhaṃ na kāñcidathaucityacamatkārakaṇikāmāviṣkaroti | sundaryāḥ ityatra padamanurūpaṃ syāt | anyāni vā niratiśarūpalāvaṇyavyavyañjakāni | tanvīpadaṃ tu virahavidhuraramaṇījane nrayuktamathaucityaśo janayati | yathā śrīharṣasya parimlānaṃ pīnastanajaghanasa ṅagādubhayatastanormakṣyasyāntaḥ parimalanamaprāpya haritam | ida vyastanyāsaṃ ślabhujalatākṣepavalanaiḥ, kṛśāṅacāḥ santāpaṃ vadati visinīpatraśayanam || atra sāgarikāyā virahāvasthāsūcakaṃ kṛśāḍagacāḥ itipadaṃ paramaucityaṃ puṣṇāti || 11 || vākyagataucityaṃ darśayitumāha aucityaracitaṃ vākyaṃ satataṃ saṃmataṃ satām | tyāgodagramivaṃśvayra śīlojjavalamiva śrutam || 12 || aucityaracitaṃ vākyaṃ kāvyavivekavicaṇānāmabhimatatamam | yathā mama vinayavallayām yugmakam devo dayāvānvijayo jitātmā yamau manaḥ saṃyamamānanīyau | iti buvāṇaḥ svabhujaṃ pramāṣiṭa yaḥ kīcakākālikakāladaṇḍam || kṣīraḥ sa kirmorajaṭāsurāriḥ kuberaśauryapraśamapopadeṣṭo | dṛṣṭo hiḍimbādayitaḥ kurūpāṃ paryantarekhāgaṇanākṛtāntaḥ || atra bhomasya bhīmacaritocitakocakākālikakāladaṇḍahiḍimbādayitādibhiḥ padairudrarausvarūpānurūpo vākyārthaḥ sajīva iva bhāsate | athavā rāśekharasya sambankṣī purubhūbhujāṃ manasijavyāpāradīkṣāgurugaurāṅagīvadanopamāparicitastārabadhūvallabhaḥ | sadyomājiṃtadākṣiṇātyataruṇodantāvadātadyutiścandraḥ sundari dṛśyatāmayamitaścaṇḍośacūḍāṇiḥ || atrāpi candramasaḥ śrṛṅagārāntaraṅaiga ranaṅagoddīpanaiḥ padainiṃrvartito vākyārthaḥ sarvathaucityasāmarthyena samucitārthavaśenātyarthamatyantamarthanīyatāṃ prāptaḥ | na tu yathāsyaiva nāle śauryamahotpalasya vipule setau samidvārigheḥ śaśvatkhaḍgabhuṅagacandanatarau krauḍopakṣāne śriyaḥ | ākāne jayakuñjarasya sudṛśāṃ kandarpadarpe paraṃ śrīduryokṣanadoṣṇi vikramapare līnaṃ jagannandatu || atrātiśayaparakarkaśasotkarṣasubhaṭabhujastajastambhasyāsamucitena kuvalayanālatulādhiropaṇena vākyārthaḥ sopahāsatayeva nibaddhaḥ parijñāyate || 12 || prabankṣārthaucityaṃ darśa yitumāha ucitārthavaśeṣeṇa prabankṣārthaḥ prakāśate | guṇprabhāvabhavyena vibhaveneva sajjanaḥ || 13 || amlānapratibhāprakarṣotprekṣitena sakalaprabandhārthāpyāyiyīyūṣavarṣeṇa samucitārthaviśeṣeṇa mahākāvyaṃ camatkārakāritāmāpadyate | yathā kālidāsasya jātaṃ baṃśe bhuvanavivite puṣkarāvartakānāṃ, jānāmi tvāṃ prakṛtipuruṣaṃ kāmarūpaṃ maghonaḥ | tenāthiṃtvaṃ vidhiparavaśād dūrabandhurgato'haṃ yācña moghā varamadhiguṇe nākṣame labdhakāmā || atrācetanasya cetanākṣyāroṇa meghasya dautyayogyatākṣānāya prathitapuṣkarāvartakaparjanyavaṃśatvamamātyaprakṛtipuruṣatvañca yadupanyastaṃ tenasamastaprabandhasyotpre kṣitetivṛttaruciratarasya niratiśayamaucityamudyotitam | yathā vā bhavabhūteḥ yo'yamaśvaḥ patākeyamathavā vīraghoṣaṇā | saptalokaikavīrasya daśakaṇkuladviṣaḥ || latraḥ aho santāpanānyakṣarāṇi | bho, bhoḥ kimakṣatriyā pṛthivī yadevamudghuṣyate | āḥ kiṃ nāma sphuranti śastrāṇi | jyājihvayā valayitotkaṭakoṭidaṃṣṭramudgārighoṣaghanaghargha raghoṣametat | grāsaprasaktahasadantakavaktrayantrajṛmabhāviḍambivikraṭovarasastu cāpam || atrārthe rāmāyaṇakathātikrameṇa nṛtanotprekṣitā rāmatanayasya sahajavikramānusāriṇī śauryotkarṣabhūmiḥ parapratāpaspasparśasahiṣṇutā prabandhasya rasabandhurāmaucityacchāyāṃ prayacchati | rāvaṇo yatpārvatīhaṭhakacagrahaṇaprīṇīpāṇau sthitaṃ purabhidaḥ śaradāṃ sahastram | gorvāṇasārakaṇanimiṃtagātramatratanmaithilīkrayadhanaṃ dhanurāvirastu || janaka āvirastu samamaga rbha sambhavayā sītayā | atra 'āvirastu samaṃ sītayā' iti janakarājena yaducyate tenānāsya viśitāśanāya tanayāpratipādanamabhitamivopalakṣyate | nacaitadvihmaḥ kathaṃ bhakṣyabhūtā kumumakomalāṅagī puruṣādāya pratipādyate, ityanaucityena prasiddhaṃ vṛttavaiparītyaṃ paraṃ hṛdayavisaṃvādamādakṣāti | yathā vā kālīdāsasya ūrumūlanakhamārgapaṃktibhistatkṣaṇaṃ hṛtavilocano haraḥ | vāsasaḥ praśithilasya saṃyamaṃ kurvatīṃ priyatamāmavārayat || atrāmbikāsaṃbhogavarṇane pāmaranārīsamucicitarlajjasajjanakharājivirājitorumūlahṛtavilocanatvaṃ trikocanasya bhagavatastrijagadguroryadukte tenānaucityame va paraṃ prabandhārthaḥ puṣṇati || 13 || guṇaicityaṃ darśayitumāha prastutārthocitaḥ kāvye bhavye bhavyaḥ saubhāgyavān guṇaḥ| syandatondurivānandaṃ saṃbhogāvasaroditaḥ || 14 || prastutārthasyaucityenaujaḥprasādamādhuryasaukurmāyādilakṣaṇo guṇaḥ kāvye bhavyaḥ saubhāgyavattāmavāptaḥ sahṛvayānandasandohaminduriva syandati | atra vipralambhabharabhagnadhai ryāyāḥ kādambaryā virahavyathāvarṇanā mādhuryasaukumāryādiguṇayogena pūrṇendudaneva priyaṃvadatvena hṛdayānandadāyinīṃ dayitatamatāmātano ti | ta tu yathā candrakasya yuddheṣu bhāgyacaleṣu na me pratijñā daivaṃ niyacchati jayañca parājayañca | eṣaiva me raṇagatasya sadā pratijñā paśyanti yanna rivapavo jaghanaṃ hayānām || atra kṣātravṛttirivaujasā kāvyaguṇenāspṛṣṭā subhaṭoktirucitārthāpi tejojovitavirahitā durgatagṛhadīpaśikheva mandāyamānā na vidyotate | yathā vā rājaśekharasya etasyāḥ smarasaṃjvaraḥ karatalasparśaiḥ parīkṣyo na yaḥ, snigkṣenāpi janena dāhabhayataḥ prasthampacaḥ pāthasām | nivīṃryīkṛtacandanauṣakṣivikṣau tasmiṃstaḍatkāriṇo, lājasphoṭamamī sphuṭanti maṇayaḥ sarve'pi hārastrajām || atra virahavikṣuraramaṇīmanobhavāvasthānurūpaṃ mākṣuryamutsṛjya taḍatkāriṇo lājasphoṭaṃ sphuṭantītyojaḥsphūrjitorjitasvabhāvākṣipāsitā sūktirlāvaṇyapeśalaturla litalalaneva paruṣabhāṣiṇī jñaṭityanaucityaṃ cetasi sañcārayati || 14 || alaṅakāraucityaṃ darśayitumāha athaicityavatā sūktiralaṅakāreṇa śobhate | pītastanasthiteneva hāreṇa hariṇekṣaṇā || 15 || prastutārthasyaucityenopamotprekṣādinālaṅagāreṇa sūktiścakāsti kāminīvoccakucacu mbinā ruciramuktākalāpena | yathā śrīharṣasya viśrāntavigrahakatho ratimāñjanasya citte vasan priyavasantaka eva sākṣāt | paryutsuko nijamahotsavadarśanāya vatseśvaraḥ kusumacāpa havābhyupaiti || atra vatseśvarasya kusumacāpenopamā śrṛṅagārāvasarasarasacārutaratāmaucityena kāmapi cetaścamatkāriṇīmāviṣkaroti | natu yathā candrakasya khagotkṣiptairantraistaruśirasi doleva racitā, śivā tṛptāhārā svapiti ratikhinneva vanitā | tṛṣārto gomāyuḥ sarudhiramasiṃ leḍhi bahuśo, bilānveṣī sarpo hatagajakārāgreṃ praviśati || atrānucitasthānasthitāyāḥ puruṣapiśitatṛptasuṭatāyāḥ śivāyāḥ suratakelivalāntakāntayā vicchayaivopamā paraṃ vaivarītyaṃ prakāśayati | yathā vā mālavarudrasya abhinavavakṣūroṣāsvādaḥ karīṣatanūnapādasaralajāśleṣakūrastuṣārasamīraṇaḥ | galitavibhavasyājñavādya dyutirmasṛṇā raveviṃrahivanitāvaktraupamyaṃ bibhatiṃ niśākaraḥ || atra komalakāminīkopena karīṣakṛśānoḥ sādṛśyaṃ śītasamayasvādutayā hṛdayasaṃvādasundaramapyanucitatvena sahasaiva cetasaḥ saṅakocamivādakṣāti | yathā vā rājaśekharasya citācakraṃ candraḥ kusumadhanuṣo dagdhavapuṣaḥ, kalaṅakastatratyaḥ spṛśati malināṅagārakalanām | yadetatsajyotirdaradalitakarpūrakṣavalaṃ, marudibharbhasmaitatprasarati vikīrṇaṃ diśi diśi || atrāpyānandisukṣāvasyandasundarasyendościtācakratvamanucitatayā karṇakaṭṛkamātaṅakamivātanoti | yo'rthastu hṛdayasaṃvādī sa yadyanaucityasparśa leśarahitastadā'kṣikatarāmalaṅakāraśo bhāṃ puṣṇati | yathā kārpaṭikasya śītenādghṛṣitasya māṣaśimivacyintārṇave majjataḥ, śāntāgniṃ sphuṭitākṣarasya kṣamataḥ kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhasya me | nidrā kvāpi vimāniteva dayitā satyajya dūraṃ gatā, satpātrapratipāditeva vasukṣā na kṣīyate śarvarī || atrānaucityasparśaparihāreṇa kevalaṃ hṛdayasaṃvāsaundaryameva svādutamādakṣāti || 15 || rasaucityaṃ darśayitumāha kurvansavaśiye vyāptimaucityaruciro rasaḥ | madhumāsa ivāśokaṃ karotyaṅkuritaṃ manaḥ || 16 || aucityena bhrājiṣṇuḥ śrṛṅagārādilakṣaṇo rasaḥ sakalajanahṛdayavyāpī vasanta ivāśokamaṅkuritaṃ manaḥ karoti | yathā śrīharṣasya uddāmotkalikāṃ vipāṇḍurarucaṃ prārabdhajṛmbhāṃ kṣaṇādāyāsaṃ śvasanodgamairavimairaviralairātanvatīmātmanaḥ || adyodyānalatāmimāṃ samadanāṃ nārīmivānyāṃ kṣruvaṃ paśyankopavipāṭaladyuti mukhaṃ devyāḥ kariṣyāmyaham || atrerṣyāvipralambharūpasya śrṛṅagārarasasya vāsavadattāyāmavekṣyamāṇasya nabamālikālatāyā lalitavanitātulyatayā virahāvasthāropeṇa nitarāmaucityaruciracamatkārakāriṇī dīptirupapāditā | yathā vā kālidāsasya bālenduvakrāṇyavikāsabhāvādvabhuḥ palāśānyatilohitāni | sadyo vasantena sagātānāṃ nakhakṣatānīva vanasthalīnām || atra pārvatyāṃ parameśvarasyābhilāṣaśrṛṅagāre vakṣyamāṇe prathamamuddīpanavibhāvabhūtasya vasantasya varṇanāyāṃ kāmukādhyāropeṇa vanasthalīlalanānāṃ kuṭilalohitapalāśakalikābhirnavasaṃgamayogyanakhakṣatāyutprekṣitāni paramāmaucityacārutāṃ pratipādayanti | natu yathāsyaiva varṇaprakarṣe sati karṇikāraṃ dunoti nirgandhatayā sma cetaḥ | prāyeṇa sāmagray vidhau guṇānāṃ parāṅmukhī viśvasṛjaḥ pravṛttiḥ|| atra kevalakarṇikārakusumavarṇanamātreṇa vidhātṛvācyatāga rbheṇaiva prastutaśrṛṅagārānupayoginā taduddīpanavibhāvocitaṃ na kiñcidabhihitam | hāsyarase yathā mama lāvaṇyavatīnāmni kāvye sīdhusparśa bhayānna cumbasi mukhaṃ kiṃ nāsikāṃ gūhase, re re śrotriyatāṃ tanoṣi viṣamāṃ mando'si veśyāṃ vinā | ityuktvā madaghūrṇamānanayanā vāsantikā mālatī līnasyātrivasoḥ karoti vakulasyevāsavāsecanam || atra śrotriyasyātrivasorapavitrasīdhusparśa śaṅakāsaṅakocanilīnasya śuṣyakabakulavṛkṣasyeva sarasatāpadanāya vedaśavilāsinyā yadāsavāsecanaṃ tadaṅagabhūtaśrṛṅagārarasā bhāsasparśena hāsyarasasya varāsavasyeva sahakārarasavedhena sacamatkārasaucityamācirnoti | yathā vā mama lāvaṇyavatyāmeva mārge ketakasūcibhinnacaraṇā sītkāriṇī keralī, ramyaṃ ramyamaho punaḥ kuru viṭenetyarthitā sasmitā | kāntā dancatuṣkabimbitaśaśijyotsnāpaṭena kṣaṇaṃ dhūrtālokanalajjiteva tanute manye mukhācchadanam || atrāpi hāsyarasasya kuṭilaviṭanarmoktivacanaucityenaśrṛṅagārarasābhāsādhivāsitasya sacamatkāraḥ paraḥ paripoṣaḥ samunviṣati | natu yathā śyāmalakasya cumbanasaktaḥ so'syā daśanaṃ cyutamātmano vadanāt | jihvāmūlaprāptaṃ khāḍiti kṛtvā niraṣṭhīvat || atra hāsyarasasya bībhatsarasādhivāsitasya laśuliptasyeva kusumaśekha rasyāvijugupsitatvādanīpsitasya paramānaucityena camatkārastirohitaḥ | vṛddhāparicumbane jihvāmūlaprāptasya cyutadaśanasya kaṇṭhalīlinaḥ ṣṭhīvanena bībhatsasyaiva prādhānyam, natu hāsyarasasya | karuṇe yathā mama munimatamīmāṃsāyām pratyagropanatābhimanyunidhane hā vatsa hā putraketyaśmadrāvi subhadrayā pralapitaṃ pārthasya yattatpuraḥ | yenodvāṣpavimuktaśaṣpakalaiḥ senāturaṅaigarapi, nyañcatpārśvagataikakarṇakuhatairniḥspandamandaṃ sthitam || atra pratyagropanatapriyataratanayaviyogopajanitaśokākhyasthāyibhāvocitaṃ dṛṣatāmapi hṛdayadrāvaṇaṃ subhadrayā yatpralapitaṃ tadarju nacetasi pratiphalitaṃ na kevalamuddīptatamupagataṃ yāvattiraścāṃ turaṅagamāṇāmapyantaḥ saṃkrantamudvāṣyavimuktaśaṣpakalaniḥspandamandasthitādibhiranubhāvairudīrṇataruṇakaruṇarasapratipartiṃ kimapyāvadhāti | natu yathā parimalasya hā śrṛṅagārataraṅigaṇīkulagire hā pratatotsavabahujanabhojanapaṅktāvaparijñātaḥ svayamiva madhye samupaviṣṭaḥ paścādabhivyaktaḥ paraṃ lajjādurmanā anaucityaṃ pratanoti || 25 || kālaucityaṃ darśayitumāha kālaucityena yātyeva vākyamarthena cārutām | janāvarjanaramyeṇa veṣeṇeva satāṃ vapuḥ || 26 || kālakṛtaucityayuktenārthena vākyaṃ cārutāmeti veṣaparigraheṇeva kālayogyena satāmavasarajñānāṃ vapuḥ | yathyā mama munimatamīmāṃsāyām yo'bhūda gopiśiśuḥ payodadhiśiraścauraḥ karīṣaṅakaṣa stasyaivādya jagatpate khagapate śaure murāre hare | śrīvatsāṅaka ! jahairiti stutipadaiḥ karṇau nṛṇāṃ pūritau, hī kālasya viparyayapraṇayinī pākakriyāścaryabhūḥ || atrāmarṣaviṣaviṣamāviṣkāramumūrṣuṇā śiśupālenābhidhīyamāne yatkila gopalabālaḥ payodadhiśiraścauraḥ karīṣaṅakaṣo'bhūttasyaivādya jagannāthādibhiḥ stutipadairnu ṇāṃ karṇau pūritau hī bata kālasya viparyayakāriṇī pākakriyā''carya bhūmiriti vākyebhūditi bhūtakālenāścaryapariṣoṣaruciramārabdhādhikṣa palakṣaṇaṃ vakyaucityaṃ kṛtam | yathā vā mālavakuvalayasya cyatutasumanasaḥ kundāḥ puṣpodgamairalasā drumā, manasi ca giraṃ gṛhṇantīme kiranti na kokilāḥ | atha ca savituḥ śītollāsaṃ lulanti marīcayo na ca jaraṭhatāmaralambante klamodiyadāyinīm || atra śiśutaravasantakāntopavananavarasollāsasūcyamānamanasijotkaṇṭhāvarṇanāyāmṛtumandhisamucitāḥ kundāḥ kusumāvasānaśūnyatanavaḥ, kiṃśukāśokāḥ kalikodgamabharālasāḥ, manasi kokilāḥ kalakūjitānyanusandadhati, rabermarīcayaḥ śītolkāsamatha ca nivārayanti na ca santāpadāyinīṃ prauḍhatāmālambante ityukte vartamānakālapadeṣveva hṛdayasaṃvādasundaramaucityaṃ kimapyāmodate | yathā ca bhūṭṭabhallaṭasya mṛtyorāsyamivātataṃ dhanuridaṃ murcchadviṣāścaṣevaḥ, śikṣā sā vijitārjunā pratilayaṃ sarvāṅagalagnā gatiḥ | antaḥkauryamaho śaṭhasya madhuno hā hāri gītaṃ mukhe, vyādhasyāsya yathā bhaṣyiyati tathā manye vanaṃ nirmṛgam || atra lubdhakasya dhanuḥ sāyakaśikṣāgatikrauryagītāni tathā yathā vanaṃ nirmṛgaṃ bhaviṣyatīti bhaviṣyatkālaḥ prakakṛtārthaparipoṣeṇa hṛdayasaṃvādaucityamādadhāti | na tu yathā varāhamihirasya kṣīṇaścandro viśati taraṇermaṇḍalaṃ māsi māsi labdhvā kāñcitpunarapi kalāṃ dūradūrānuvartī | smpūrṇaścetkathamapi tadā sparddhayodeti bhānorno daurjanyādiramati jaḍo nāpi dainyādvacaraṃsīt || atra ravermaṇḍalaṃ kṣīṇaḥ śaśī pratimāsaṃ praviśati tataḥ kāñcidāpyāyikāṃ kalāṃ prāpya dūre dūre bhavati,paripūrṇaśca tasyaiva sparddha yā'bhyudeti, daurjanyānnā viramati na ca dainyādvacaraṃsīdityetad viramati vyaraṃsīt iti parasparāsaṅagataṃ kālapadadvayaṃ candrasya sadṛśayordaurjanyayoḥ sarvakālamabhinirvu tayoryadupanyastaṃ tatra vyaraṃsīditi virudvārthatvādanucitameva || 26 || veśaucityaṃ darśayitumāha deśaucityena kāvyārthaḥ sasaṃvādena śobhate | paraṃ paricayāśaṃsī vyavahāraḥ satāmiva || 27 || deśaviṣayaucityena hṛdayasaṃvādinā kāvyārthaḥ satāṃ vyavahāra iva paricayasūcakaḥ śobhate | yathā bhaṭṭabhavabhūteḥ purā yatra strotaḥ pulinamadhunā tatra saritāṃ viparyāsaṃ yāto ghanaviralabhāvaḥ kṣitiruhām | bahordṛ ṣṭaṃ kālādaparamiva manye vanamidaṃ niveśaḥ śailānāṃ tadidamiti buddhiṃ draḍhayati || atra bahubhirvarṣairatikrāntai śambūkavadhaprasaṅegana daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ rāmaḥ pūrvapiricataṃ punaḥ praviṣṭaḥ samāntādavalokyaivaṃ brūte purā yatra nadīnāṃ pravāhastatrekadānīṃ taṭam, vṛkṣāṇāṃ ghanaviralatve viparyayaścirād dṛṣṭaṃ vanamidamapūrvamiva manye, parvatasanniveśastu tadevaitaditi buddhiṃ sthirīkarīti ityukte cirakālaviparyaparivṛttasaṃsthānakarānakānanavarṇanayā hṛdayasaṃvādī deśasvabhāvaḥ paramaucityamuddyotayati | na tu yathā rājaśekharasya karṇaṭīdaśānāṅikataḥ sitamahārāṣṭrīkaṭākṣāhataḥ, prauḍhāndhrīstanapīhitaḥ praṇayinībhrūbhaṅagavitrāsitaḥ | lāṭībāhuviveṣṭitaśca malayastrītarjanītarjitaḥ, so'yaṃ samprati rājaśekharakavirvārāṇasīṃ vāñchati || atra karṇaṭamahārāṣṭrāndhralāṭamalayalalanāsambhogasubhagaḥ kālena galitarāgamohaḥ samprati rājaśekharakavirvārāṇasīṃ gantumicchatītyukte śrṛṅagārarasataraṅigatavarāṅaganāprasaṅega'naṅaganirargaladakṣiṇāpayathadeśodde śa madhyepraṇayinībhrū bhaṅgavitrāsita iti deśopalakṣaṇāvirahitakevalapraṇayinīpadena deśaucityamupacitamapyanucitatāṃ nītam || 27 || kulaucityaṃ darśayitumāha kulopacitamaucityaṃ viśeṣetkarṣakāraṇam kāvyasya puruṣasyeva priyaṃ prāyaḥ sacetasām || 28 || puruṣasyeva kāvyasya kulonnatamaucitṛyaṃ saviśeṣotkarṣajanakaṃ prāyeṇa bāhulyena sahṛdayānāmabhimatam | yathā kālidāsasya atha sa viṣayavyāvṛttātmā yathāvidhi sūnave nṛpatikakudaṃ dattvā yūne sitātapavāparaṇam | munivanatarucchāyāṃ devyā tayā saha śiśriye galitavayasāmikṣvākūṇāmidaṃ hi kulavratam || atrātha sa rājā vṛddhastaruṇāya sūnave rājyaṃ pratipādya tayā devyā saha tapovanaṃ bheje, viraktacetasāmikhvākūṇāmante hi kulavratīmadameva ityukte bhūtavartamānabhāvināṃ tadvaṃśyānāmaucityamunmīlitam | na tu yathā yaśovarmaṃdevasya utpattirbhaṇḍakule yadabhīṣṭaṃ tatpadaṃ samākrāntam | bhogāstathāpi daivātsakṛdipa bhoktaṃ na labhyante || atra mamotpattirbhaṇḍakule samīhitapadākramaṇaṃ ca niṣpannaṃ tathāpi daivārpitapriyāviyogādabhogā bhoktu na labhyanta ityabhihite svasaṃvedyameva bhaṇḍakulamanyatrāprasiddhaṃ svayameva nirdidiśyamānamutkarṣaviśeṣaṇavirahitakevalapadodanena nirarthakatayā niraucityameva | ikṣvākukulasya tu nirviśeṣaṇatvamupapadyata eva, tribhuvanaprasidvaucityacaritratvāt || 28 || vrataucityaṃ darśayitumāha kāvyārthaḥ sādhuvādāhaṃḥ sadvrataucityagauravāt | santoṣanirbharaṃ bhaktyā karoti janamānasam || 29 || kāvyārthaḥ samucitatavratagauravātsadhuvāvādayogyaḥ santoṣapūrṇaṃ janamanaḥ karoti | bhaktiviṃcchittiḥ | yathā mama muktāvalīkāvye atra valkalajuṣaḥ palāśinaḥ puṣpareṇubharabhasmabhūṣitāḥ| lolabhṛṅagavalayākṣamālikāstāpasā iva vibhānti pādapāḥ ||
atra tapodhanociṃvratavyañjakavalkalabhasmākṣasūtrapra ṇayipādapavarṇanāyāmacetanāmapi śamasamayavila cittavṛttiraucityupananayati | na tu yathā dīpakasya puṇye grāme vane vā mahati sitapaṭacchannapālīkapālīmādāya nyāyagarbhadvijahutahutabhugdhūmopakaṇṭham | dvāraṃ dvāraṃ pravṛtto varamudaradarīpūraṇāya kṣudhārtomānī prāṇī sanātho na punaranudinaṃ tulyakulyeṣu dīnaḥ|| atra vairāgyanirargalavarṇanāyāṃ bhikṣākapalīmādāya kṣutkṣāmaḥ kukṣipuraṇāya pravṛtto mānī varaṃ dvāraṃ dvāraṃ yaṣṭiniviṣṭapāṇiḥ paribhrānto na punaraniśaṃ tulyukulyeṣu dīna ityukte sahajapraśamavimala mānasaviśrāntisantoṣāmutsṛjya tulyukulyadveṣavijigīṣāparameva vākyaṃ bhṛśamanaucityamudabhāvayati | varametattīvravratakaṣṭaṃ na tu svajanadainyāyacanamiti saṃsāragranthibandhābhimānoyanyāsaḥ || 29 || tattvaicityaṃ darśayitumāha kāvyaṃ hṛdayasaṃvādi satyapratyayaniścayāt | tattvocitābhidhānena yātpayupādeyatāṃ kaveḥ || 30 || tattvocitākhyānena kaveḥ sūktaṃ satyapratyasyairyātsaṃvadi gṛhmatāṃ yāti | yathā mama bauddhāvadānalotikāyām divi bhūvi phaṇikoke śaiśave yauvane vā jarasi nidhanakāle garbhaśayyāśraye vā | sahagamanasahiṣṇoḥ sarvathā dehabhājāṃ nahi bhavati vināśaḥ karmaṇaḥ prāktanasya || atra prāktanasya karmaṇastrailokye śaiśavayauvanavṛddhatvāsthāsu dehināṃ sahagamane samarthatvānnā vināśo'stītyukte niḥsaṃśayasakalajanahadayasaṃvāditattvākhyānamaucityaṃ khyāpayati | na tu yathā māghasya bubhakṣitaivyakiraṇaṃ na bhujyate na pīyate kāvyarasaḥ pipāsitaiḥ | na vidyayā kenaciduddhṛtaṃ kulaṃ hiraṇyamevārjaya niṣphalāḥ kalāḥ || atrāyarthārthāthiṃthatāparatvena dhanamevārjaya, kṣudhitairvyākakaraṇaṃ na bhujyate, na ca kāvyarasaḥ pipāsitaiḥ pīyate, na ca vidyayā kulaṃ kenaciduddhṛtamityukte sarvametaddāridracadainyavidrutadhairyakātaratāyā tattvavirahitaṃ viparītamupanyastamanaucityasayuktameva | vidyāānāmeva sarvasampatprasapivanīnāṃ kuloddhārakṣamatvaṃ nānyasya || 30 || sattvaicityaṃ darśayitumāha camatkāraṃ karotyeva vacaḥ sattvocitaṃ kaveḥ | vicārīrucirodāracaritaṃ sumateriva || 31 || sattvocitaṃ kavervacaścamatkāraṃ karoti, sumateriva vicāryamāṇaṃ ruciramudāravaritam | yathā mama citrabhārate nāṭake nadīvṛndoddāmaprasarasalilāpṛritatanuḥ, sphuratsphītajvālāniviḍavaḍavāgnikṣatajalaḥ | na darpaṃ no dainyaṃ spṛśati bahusayattvaḥ pītarapāmavasthānāṃ bhedādabhavati vikṛtirnaiva mahatām || atra payodhivyapadeśena yudhiṣṭhirasya sattvotkarṣe'bhidhīyamāne saritpūrapravardhitatanurvaḍavāgniniṣpītaśca notsekaṃ na saṅakocamabdhirvipulasattvaḥ spṛśati, na hmavasthānāṃ bhedānmahāśayānāṃ vikāro bhavatītyukte gambharīradhīrā sattvavṛttiraucityamātanoti | na tu yathā bhaṭṭendurājasya āścaryaṃ vaḍavānalaḥ sa bhagavānāścaryamambho nidhiryatkarmātiśayaṃ vicintya manasaḥ kampaḥ samutpadyate | ekasyāśayaghasmarasya pibatastṛptirna jātā jalairanyasyāpi mahātmano na vapuṣi svalpo'pi jātaḥ śramaḥ || atra vaḍavānalasamudrayoḥ sattvamahattve vakṣyamāṇe nātivipulāśayatvādekasya pibataḥ, payobhistṛptinaṃ jātā, dvitīyasya tadupajīvyamānasya na manāgapi khedaḥ, tadetadubhayamāścaryamityukte niḥsantoṣatayā satatayā ca kasya na vaḍavāgnerlajjā na ca jalanigherāśritaikārthipūraṇasāmarthyamityasattve sattvastutiranaucityamāvahati || 31 || abhiprāyaucityaṃ darśayitumāha akadarthanayā sūktamabhiprāyasamarthakam | cittamāvarjayatyeva satāṃ svasthamivārjavam || 32 || akleśenābhiprāyasamarthakaṃ kāvyaṃ hṛdayamāvarjayati, sajjanānāṃ nirmalamārja vamiva | yathā dīpakasya śyenāhiṅdhragrahadāritottarakaro jyāṅagaprakoṣṭhāntara, ātābhrādharapāṇipādanayanaprāntaḥ pṛthūraḥ sthalaḥ | manye'yaṃ dvijamadhyago nṛpasutaḥ ko'pyamba ! niḥśamkalaḥ, putryevaṃ yadi koṣṭhametu sukṛtaiḥ prāpto viśeṣātithiḥ || atra svairaramaṇī ramaṇīyaṃ divasāvasāne yuvānaṃ pathikamālokyābhiprāyasūcakaṃ jananīmevaṃ brūte yadasau rājaputrākṛtiḥ śyenagrahanārācaparicayocitaḥ sāyaṃsamaye prāptaḥ hatyukte mātrāpyabhiprāyapūrakamabhihitam putri ! yadyevaṃ tatkoṣṭhāṅaṃka praviśatu sukṛtairviśeṣo'tithiḥ prāptaḥ pūjya ityetena sphuṭābhiprāyasūcakamaucityamupacitamācakāsti | na tu yathā'syaivaayi virahavicitte ! bharturarthe tathārtā sapadi, nipatitā tvaṃ pādayoścaṇḍikāyāḥ | svayamupahitadhūpasthālakacchatraśrṛṅagoddalitamapi lalāṭaṃ yena naivālalakṣe || atrāvinayadatyāḥ sucirātpatpayāvagate lalāṭanakhollekhāpahnavavacane sakhyā samupadiśyamāne he virahonmatte bharturarthe caṇiḍakāpādapatane svayaṃ sthāpitadhūpasthālako ṭikṣatamani na lakṣitaṃ bhavatyā lalāṭamityuktau svairāpahnavaśikṣāmātramevopalakṣyate, na tu tasyāḥ sakhyā vā kaścidabhiprāyaviśeṣaḥ || 32 || svabhāvautyiṃ darśaṃyitumāhasvabhāvaucityamābhāti sūktīnāṃ cāru bhūṣaṇam | akṛtrimamasāmānyaṃ lāvaṇyamiva yoṣitām || 33 || yathā mama munimatamīsāyāmkarṇottālitakuntalāntanipatattoyakṣaṇāsaṅiganā, hāreṇeva vṛtastanī pulakitā śītena sītkāriṇī | nirdhautāñjanaśoṇakoṇanayanā snānāvasāne'ṅaganā, prasyandatkabarībharā na kurute kasya spṛhārdraṃ manaḥ || atra vyāsasūnoḥ śukasya gāḍhavairāgyaniḥsaṅagasya, gaganagaṅagātīre snātottīrṇāstridaśayoṣito vivasanāstaddarśananiḥsaṅakocāḥ paśyataḥ praśamavimalamanasaḥ smaravyatikaranirvikāratāyāṃ karṇamūlotkṣiptālakaparyantanipatattoyakaṇasantānena stanayoḥ kṛtamuhūrtahārāvibhramā, śītena romāñcasītkāriṇī, dhautāñjanāruṇanayanāntā, prastravanmuktakeśakalāpā, snānottīrṇā taruṇī kasya spṛhārdra na mamaḥ karotītyukte svayamārdra svabhāvaḥ paramapyārdrīkarotītyucitametat | na tu yathā mama tatraiva bhaktiḥ kātaratāṃ kṣamā sabhayatāṃ pūjyastutirdīnatāṃ, dhairyaṃ dāruṇatāṃ matiḥ kuṭilatāṃ vidyābalaṃ kṣobhatām | dhyānaṃ vañcakatāṃ tapaḥ kuhakatāṃ śīlavrataṃ ṣaṇḍhatāṃ, paiśunyavratināṃ girāṃ kimiva vā nāyāti doṣārdra tām || atra piśunasvabhāve varṇyamāne bhaktayādīnāṃ guṇānāṃ vaivaparītye pratipādite piśunānāṃ vacasāṃ kiṃ vā doṣārdratāṃ nāyātītyabhihite svaya manārdra svabhāvasya paśardrīkaraṇamanucitameva || 33 || sārasaṅgrahaucityaṃ darśayitumāha sārasaṅgrahavākyena kāvyārthaḥ phalaniścitaḥ | adīrghasūtravyāpāra iva kasya na smmataḥ || 34 || sārasaṃgrahavākyena kāvyārthaḥ suniścitaphalaḥ śīghrakāriṇa iva vyāpāraḥ kasya nābhimataḥ | yathā mama munimatamīmāṃsāyām vividhagahanagarbhagranthasambhārabhārairmunibhirabhiniviṣṭaistattvamuktaṃ na kiñcit | kṛtaruciravicāraṃ sārametanmaharṣerahamiti bhavabhūmirnāhamityeva mokṣaḥ || atra bhagavadgītārthavicāre sārasaṃgraho'bhihito yatkila munibhiranekabhevabhinnaśāstrajahairabhiviṣṭamabhiniviṣṭamatibhistattvamupādeyaṃ na kiñcatkathitam | bhagavato maharṣervyāsasya sumatervimalavicārottīrṇa niścitametadeva yadahaṅakāraḥ saṃsāramūlabhūmirmamatapārityāga eva mokṣa iti tatsaṃkṣepeṇa bhayakṣayopadeśaḥ prakṛtārthasya paramamaucityaṃ puṣṇāti | na tu yathā parivrajakasya tapo na taptaṃ vayameva taprā bhogā na bhuktā vayameva bhuktāḥ|jarā na jīrṇa vayameva jīrṇastṛṣṇā na yātā vayameva yātāḥ|| pratibhaucityaṃ darśayitumāha pratibhābharaṇaṃ kāvyamucitaṃ śobhate kaveḥ | nirmalaṃ suguṇasyeva kulaṃ bhūtivibhūṣitam || 35 || yathā mama lāvaṇyavatyām adaya ! daśasi kiṃ tvaṃ bimbabuddhacādharaṃ me bhava vapala nirāśaḥ pakvajambūphalānām | iti dayitamavetya dvāradeśāptamanyā nigadati śukamucyaiḥ kāntadantakṣatauṣṭhī || atra kayāpi dvāraveśāptaṃ priyaṃ jñātvā vanyakāmukadaśanakhaṇiḍatoṣṭhacā samprati tadāgamana|nabhijñasayeva śumamuddiśya yaduktaṃ nidaṃya kiṃ ! tvaṃ bimbaphalalobhādadhara mama vidārayasi, pakvānāṃ jmbūphalānāmidānīṃ capala nirāśo bhava, kupitā tubhyaṃ no dāsyāmīti tenoccaiḥ pratyāyanāpahnavanavanavonmeprajñācāturyacārucanamaucitcamatkāraṃ karoti | yadāha bhaṭṭatautaḥ prajñā navanavonmeṣaśālinī pratibhā matā iti | na tu yathā mama tatraiva niryāte dayite gṛhe viśayane nirmālyamālye kṛte, prāpte prātarasahmarāgiṇi pare vārāvahāre'nyathā | dvārālīnavilocanā vyasaninī suprāhamekākinītyuktvā nīvivikarvaṇaiḥ sa caraṇāghātairaśokīkṛtaḥ || atra veśyā vyālagnakāmukasya vārāvahāraṃ vidhāya navakānukena saha kṣapāyāṃ nītāyāṃ prabhāte tanniryāte śayāyākumādisambhodadisambhogalakṣaṇe nivārite vāravañcanakupite gāḍhasanurāgagrahagrastamatau pūrvakāmuke prāpte tvadālokanakāṃkhiṇī vyasaninī dvāranyastanayanāhamekākinī supteti pratyāyanāvacanavilīsanyusanamapyusarabhasasarasanīvivikarṣaṇodyatākṛtikṛterṣyākopayā caraṇanalinaprahārairaśokīkṛtaḥ śaṅakāśalyonmulanānniḥśokaḥ sampāditaḥ santatapulakāṅakaratvādaśokatarutulyatāṃ nīta iti vā vākyārthaḥ kevalayati, na tu pratibhodbhūtāmaucityakaṇikāṃ sūcayati || 35 || avasthaucityaṃ darśayitumā avasthaucityamādhatte kāvyaṃ jagati pūjyatām | vicāryamāṇaruciraṃ kartavyamiva dhīmatām || 36 || avasthocitatayā kāvyaṃ jagati ślādhyatāmāyāti, matimatāmiva kṛtyaṃ vicāranirdharṣaruciram | yathā mama lāvaṇyavatayām muktaḥ kandukavibhramastaralatā tyavaktaiva bālyocitā, maugdhyaṃ nirdhṛtamāśritā gajagatirbhrū lāsyamabhyasyate | yantarmomaṣu nirmitaṃ mṛgadṛśā vaidagdhyadivyaṃ vacastahmiḥ subhagābhimānalaṭabhābhāve nibaddho bharaḥ || atra yaduktaṃ kaṃndukakrīḍā tyakta, bālacāpalyaṃ parihitam, maugdhaṃ nirastam, gajagatiraṅagīkṛtā, bhūlatālāsyābhyāsaḥ kriyate, narmomiṣu vacanavaicitryamāsūtritam, tena jānībhahe śaiśavāvasthāṃ samutsṛjantyā prauḍhatāmanārūḍhayāpi navasambhogagauravagarbheṇa subhagābhimānena laṭabhābhāve bālayā bharo nibaddhaḥ, ityabhihite sphuṭadhiyā vayovasthāmadhyasandhivarṇanāyāmaucityaṃ sphuradivāvabhāsate | na tuthā rājaśekharasya jyāyān dhanvī navaṇdhṛtadhanustābhrahastodareṇa, kṣatrakṣodavyatikarapaṭustāṭakātāḍakena | karṇārbhāyarṇasphuritapalitaḥ kṣīrakaṇṭhena sārdhaṃ, yoddhuṃ vāñchanna kathamadhunā lajjate jāmadagnyaḥ | atra bhārgavaḥ sthāvirāvāsthāsthitaḥ sthirataparākramakakaṃśaprauḍho dhanudharaḥ śiśunā rāmeṇa dhanurgrahaṇāruṇitakomalakarakamalena kṣatriyakṣayasaṃrambhapragalstāṭakātāḍakena sphuradākarṇapalitaḥ sambhāvyamānajananīstanakṣīrakaṇṭhenāmunā yuyutsuḥ kathaṃ na lajjata ityukte peśalatāyā rāghavāvasthāyāṃ jāmadagnyāvasthāvirītatāyāṃ pratipādyamānāyāṃ tāṭakātāḍakeneti viruddhādhivāso'rthaḥ kimapyanaucityena cetasi saṅakocamādadhāti || 36 || vicāraucityaṃ darśayitumāha ucitena vicāreṇa cārutāṃ yānti sūktayaḥ | vedyatattvāvabodhena vidyā iva manīṣiṇām || 37 || vicāraucityena sūktayaścārutāṃ yānti, jñeyasvarūpajñānena vidyā iva viduṣām | yathā mama munimatamīmāṃsāyāmadhvatyathāmavadhābhidhānasamaye satyavratotsāhinā, mithyā dharmasutena jihmavacasā hastīti yad vyāhṛtam | sā satyāmṛtaraśmirvaramasamaṃ saṃsūcayantyāḥ sadā, śaṅake paṅakajasaṃśrayeṇa malinārambhā vijṛmbhā śriyaḥ || atra droṇanidhanākhyāne satyavratotsāhavatā dharmatanayenāpi mithyā laghuvacasā kuñcara iti yaduktaṃ sā satataṃ satyacandradveṣaṃ sūcayantyāḥ śriyāḥ śaṅeka paṅakajasaṃśrayeṇa malinavyāparā vijṛmbhe tyabhihite sasaṃvādalakṣmīsvabhāvaparibhāvanayā tattvāvabo dhena mūlaviśrāntyā phalaparyaṃvasāyī vicāraḥ sahṛdayasaṃvedyamaucityaṃ vyanakti | na tu yathā mama tatraiva praglāne cirakālavṛttadayitākeśāmbarākarṣaṇe, kūraṃ rākṣasavaiśasaṃ yadi kṛtaṃ bhīmena duḥśāsane | tatkālakṣamiṇā kuśāśmaparuṣāraṇyapravāse ciraṃ, kiṃ pītaṃ tatatāpamagnamahiṣasvedāmbupṛktaṃ payaḥ || atra bhīmasenacarite vicāryamāṇe trayodaśavarṣaparyuṣite kṛṣṇākeśākarṣaṇaparābhave bhīmena bhīmaṃ rākṣasakarma duḥśāsane yadi kṛtaṃ tatsadyaḥ kṛtārdrāparādhakālakṣamiṇā suciraṃ darbhasūcīviṣamāśmaparuṣavanavāse kiṃ grīṣmatāpanimagnamahiṣasvedastrutipṛktaṃ payaḥpītimityanupapannakṛtye'bhihite kāraṇavicārābhāvānnirmulovānnirmulopālambhātramanaucityamanubadhnāti || 37 || nāmaucityaṃ darśayitumāha nāmnā karmānurūpeṇa jñāyate guṇadoṣayoḥ | kāvyasya puruṣasyeva vyaktiḥ saṃvādapātinī || 38 || yathā kālidāsasya idamasulabhavastuprārthanādurnivāraḥ prathamamapi mano me pañcabāṇaḥ kṣiṇoti | kimuta malayavātāndolitāpaṇḍapatrai rupavasahakārairdarśiteṣvaṅkureṣu || atra prārambha eva mamedaṃ manaḥ pañcabāṇaḥ sudurlaṃbhavastuprārthanādurnivāraḥ śakalīkaroti kimuta līlodyānasahakārairmalayānilāndolitabāla pallavairaṅkureṣu darśiteṣvityukte madanas ñcabāṇābhidhānamucitameva | yathā vā mama bauddhāvadānalatāyām tāruṇyena nipītaśaiśavatayā sā'naṅagaśrṛṅagāriṇī, tanpaṅagacā sakalāṅagaṅagamasakhī bhaṅigarnavāṅagīkṛtā | niḥsaṃrambhaparākramaḥ pṛthutarāmbhābhiyogaṃ vinā, sābhrājye jagatāṃ yayā vijayate devo vilāsāyudhaḥ || atra yauvananipītaśaiśavatayā tanvaṅagacā'naṅagaśrṛṅagāravatī sarvāṅaga saṅagamasakhī sā kāpyabhinavā bhaṅigaraṅagīkṛtā yayā niṣprayatnaparākramaḥ prabhūtatarāmbhambhāraṃ vihāya tribhuvanasāmrājye jayati devovilāsāyudhaḥ ityukte kāmasya vilāsāyudha iti nāmapopapannameva, tanvaṅagībhaṅagacaiva siddhatrailokyādhipatvavijigīṣāyāṃ kāmasāyakādīnāṃ nairarthakyāt | na tu yathā kālidāsasya krodhaṃ prabho saṃhara saṃhareti yāvad giraḥ khe marutāṃ caranti | tāvatsa vahrirbhabanetrajanmā bhasmāvaśeṣaṃ madanaṃ cakāra || atra paśyato bhagavatastrinesya smaraśaranipātakṣobhe varṇyamānetannikāropaśamāya 'sahara saṃhara prabho krodhami'ti yāvadvacaḥ khe devānāṃ carati tāvadabhavanetrodabhavaḥ sa vahnirmadanaṃ bhasmarāśiśeṣamakārṣītityukte saṃhārāvasare rudrasya bhavābhivānamanucitameva || 38 || āśīrvacanaucityaṃ darśayitumāha pūrṇārthadājatuḥ kāvyasya santoṣitamanīṣiṇaḥ | ucitāśīrnṛ pasyeva bhavatyabhyudayāvahā || 39 || sampūrṇasamarpakasya santoṣitaviduṣaḥ kāvyasya nṛpaterivocitamāśīḥ padamabhyudayāvahaṃ bhavati | yathā'smadupādhyāyagaṅagakasya sa ko'pi premārdraḥ praṇayaparitākapracalito vilāso'kṣyāṃ deyātsumanupamaṃ vo mṛgavṛśām | yadākūtaṃ vṛṣṭvā pidadhati mukhaṃ tūṇavivare, nirastavyāpārā bhuvanajayinaḥ pañcaviśikhāḥ || atra sa ko'pyasāmānyapremārdraviśrānprigalbhakuraṅagavṛśāṃ nirupamo nayanavilāsaḥ, sukhaṃ vo deyāt, yadabhiprāyamālokya bhuvanajayinaḥ kāmasya pañcasāyakāḥ samāptavyāpārāstūṇīravivare lajjayeva mukhaṃ pidadhatī ityukte sukhaṃ vo deyādityāśīḥpadamucitameva priyānayanavibhramasya sukhārpaṇayogyatvāt | yathā vā mama vātsyāyanasūtrasāre kāmaḥ kāmaṃ kamalavadanānetraparyantavāsī dāsībhūtatribhuvanajanaḥ prītaye jāyatāṃ vaḥ | dagdhasyāpi tripuraripuṇā sarvalokaspṛhārhā yasyādhikyaṃ ruciratitarāmañjanasyeva yātā || atra kāmaḥ prītaye vo jāyatāṃ yasya dagdhasyāpyañjanasyevādhikyaṃ ruciryātetyukte prītaye jāyatāmityucitaṃ, kāmasya prītyātmakatvāt | natu yathā'marukasya ālolāmalakāvalīṃ vilulitāṃ vibhrāccalatkuṇḍalaṃ, kiñcinmṛṣṭaviśeṣakaṃ tanutaraiḥ svedābhasāṃ sīkaraiḥ | tanvaṅagacāḥ sutarāṃ ratāntasamaye vaktraṃ rativyatyaye, tattvāṃ pātu cirāya kiṃ hariharaskandādibhirdaivataiḥ || atra tanvyā rativyatyaye lolākaṃ calatkuṇḍalaṃ calatkuṇḍalaṃ svedasalilena kiñcinmṛṣṭatilakaṃ yanmukhaṃ tattvāṃ pātu kiṃ hariharaskandādibhirdaivataiḥ ityukte pātu tvāmityanucitam, ānāndayatu tvāmityucitaṃ syāt | anyeṣu kāvyāṅegaṣvanayaiva diśā svayamaucityamutpreṇīyam | tadudāharaṇānyānantyānna pradarśiśatānīta.yalamatiprasaṅagena || 40 || granthakartṛ paricayaḥ āsīt prakrāśendra iti prakāśaḥ kāśmīradeśe tridaśeśvaraśrīḥ | abhūd gṛhe yasya pavitrasattramacchinnamagrāsanamagrajānām || 1 || yaḥ śrīsvayaṃbhūbhavane vicitre dicitre lepyapratiṣṭhāpitamātṛcakraḥ | gobhūmikṛṣṇājinaveśmadātā tatraiva kāle tanumutsasarjaṃ || 2 || tasyātmajaḥ sarvamanīṣiśiṣyaḥ śrīvyāsadāparapuṇyanāmā | kṣemendra ityakṣayakāvyakīrtiścakre navaucityavicāracaryām || 3 || śrīratnasiṃhe suhṛdi prayāte śārvaṃ puraṃ śrīvijaceśarājñiḥ | tadātmajasyodayāsiṃhanāmnaḥ kṛte kṛtastena girāṃ prapañcaḥ || 4 || yasyāsiḥ parivārakṛttribhuvanaprakhyātaśīlaśrūteḥ sarvasyāvanatena yena nitarāṃ prāptā viśeṣonnatiḥ | āśāḥ śītalatāṃ nayatyavirataṃ yasya pratāpānalastasya śrīmadanantarājanṛpateḥ kāle kilāyaṃ kṛtaḥ || 5 || iti śrīprakāśendrātmajvayāsadāsaparākhyaśrīkṣemendrakṛtā 'aucityavicārarcā' samāptā ||
